title: Call Your Grandpa

description:
Grandpa Walt changed the wifi password and he is not saying what it is. Nadia and Jonah try everything, even compliments. The new password says it all.

#cartoon #animation #funny #grandpa #shorts
tiktok_caption: grandpa's house rule: new wifi password and he will not say it 📶 #cartoon #animation #funny #grandpa

lines.text: Grandpa. The wifi stopped working nine minutes ago. I am counting.
I changed the password.
Hello. I am the router. Today I am the most important person in this house.
Grandpa, what is the new password?
Guess.
That is exactly what a bad guy in a movie says.
Then I am the bad guy. Pass the crackers.
He has been the bad guy since breakfast. He unplugged me twice just to feel something.
I have a group chat with forty people in it. They think I moved to the woods.
She has been staring at me like I owe her money.
Okay. Password one. Grandpa one two three.
Wrong. And honestly, a little insulting.
Password two. Big Walt the legend.
Nobody has called me that since the bowling league.
Also wrong. But he smiled. Write that down.
He smiled? Is it bowling? Is the password bowling?
I tried meatloaf. I tried pudding. I tried the name of his truck.
Her name is Doris and she is not online.
Grandpa, this is an emergency. My phone is just a flashlight now.
Your phone is fine. It is just bored. Like a teenager.
Plan B. I crawl behind the couch and read the back of the router.
Please do not read my back. I am a private box.
It says the old password. Then a sticky note says, nice try, Jonah.
Plan C. I will be very nice to you.
Oh no.
Grandpa, you look so handsome in that sweater.
Your grandmother knitted this. It is three sizes too big. I love it.
And you smell like a very expensive pine tree.
That is the soup.
She is losing. She is complimenting soup.
Plan D. We cry.
Please, Grandpa. Please.
Fine. We give up. What do you even want?
Sit down. Both of you. On the actual couch.
Something is happening. My little lights are blinking with feelings.
When did either of you last call me?
We text you.
You send me a little thumbs up. I thought it was a sandwich.
The summer. We called you in the summer. For your birthday.
July. It is November. I counted too.
Okay. He wins the counting.
So I changed it. The new password is three words. No spaces.
What are the words?
Call. Your. Grandpa.
Call your grandpa.
Connected. Everyone is connected. Even me. I am crying in blue.
That is the most evil thing I have ever heard. And also very sweet.
I know. I had a lot of time to think. Nobody called.
I will call you every Sunday. With my face.
With your face. Good. I will wear the sweater.
I am calling you right now. You are sitting right there.
Hello? Who is this? I am a very busy man.
Can I go back to my group chat now?
Yes. But I am changing it again on Sunday.
To what?
Visit. Your. Grandpa.
